utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a decent turnout. I’ll swing by after my errands and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Ira. I’ll keep to the list and make sure everything stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks, Eli. I’ll check in when I get back and see if there’s anything I can help carry or sort.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a hand loading the donations and a quick ride to the drop-off, if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. Just let me know when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — as far as I know it’s still happening today, but I’d double-check the time and location before heading out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the time and location, then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m in, I just need to double-check what time it starts. Did you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you could bring a hammer and a box of screws, that’d be great. I’m still confirming the start time and will let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll bring a hammer and a box of screws. Just let me know the start time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s the neighborhood repair drive, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact details. If you want, I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check and send me the details when you can — I’d rather confirm the date and what’s needed before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re still on track, and folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I can give you the quick rundown if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yes please — give me the quick rundown, and let me know where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or handle?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you bring your drill and a few spare screws? I’ll handle the toolbox and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a few spare screws. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen anything about the repair drive yet—where are we meeting, and what location should I keep an eye on?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re meeting at the school parking lot near the gym entrance. Keep an eye out for the repair drive sign there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll watch for the repair drive sign by the school parking lot near the gym entrance.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a nice bit of momentum, which is lovely to see. If you want, I can pass along what folks are donating or still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be brilliant, Tess — please do pass it along. I’ll keep spreading the word and nudging folks to help where they can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know what’s coming in and what’s still needed. It’s been heartening to see people chip in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, do you want me to bring my toolbox or just help with hauling stuff?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Bring the toolbox if you can — that would help a lot. I can handle the hauling.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the toolbox. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and keep the plan moving. Let’s make sure everyone knows when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m still catching up on the details, so that would really help. If you hear anything about the time or place, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and wanted to check in on your availability. If you can help, I’ll slot you in and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa — I can help, just keep it simple for me. Tell me when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, thank you. I’ll put you down for the Saturday morning shift and send you the quick details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely — folks are pitching in with tools and spare parts. If you’re planning to help, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Tess. Please tell me what they still need, and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They still need a sturdy ladder, a box of screws, and a few cordless drills if anyone’s got extras. If you can bring one of those, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we still need help sorting the donated tools and loading the heavier boxes. If you can grab a cart, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll grab a cart and start sorting the donated tools. Point me to the heavier boxes when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Rey. I might take you up on it if I can manage a few things first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course, Uli—just let me know when you’re ready, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — could you tell me where the repair drive is taking place and what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet — I only know I can help. If you send me the details, I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking the repair drive could really bring people together—want to help me spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help with that, but let me check the details first—what time and place are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I was thinking Saturday afternoon at the community center, but I’m happy to adjust if that works better.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the latest—what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We shifted it to Saturday morning and added a table for small appliance fixes too. If you want, I can save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks—Saturday morning works better for me. Yeah, please save me a spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re gathering donated tools and pairing folks with small fixes—if you can help, I’d love you to swing by the shed after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll swing by the shed after lunch and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort donations and check off the list. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — start with sorting the donations by type, then check them off the list as you go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the logistics—how many places are we covering, and do we have a clear route yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good question — I don’t have the route locked yet, but I’m aiming to cover the main houses on our street first. How many places do you think we can realistically fit in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe 5 or 6 houses, if we keep it tight and start with the closest ones. I’d feel better if we had the route sketched out before we go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—would you be able to come by and lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can help out at the repair drive. Just let me know what supplies you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you! Could you bring some screwdrivers and a tape measure if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—just tell me what time window you’re aiming for.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Faye — I’m aiming for a late afternoon window, maybe around 4 to 6 if that works. I’ll confirm the exact time once I check with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work well for me—I’ll keep that window open and wait for your exact time once you’ve checked with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m gathering the repair drive list and keeping everything organized. If you have any homes that need help, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve only heard a couple of second-hand updates, but I’ll pass them along if I hear more. The repair drive sounds really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate it. Even a few leads help, so just send them along whenever you hear anything.
